categories.name: Mandatory / Regulatory Signs
categories.legal_effect: Violation is a punishable offence under Section 119 of the Motor Vehicles Act.

categories.name: Cautionary / Warning Signs
categories.legal_effect: Warns drivers of hazards ahead. Failure to heed may constitute dangerous driving (Section 184).

categories.name: Informatory / Guide Signs
categories.legal_effect: Provides facility directions and guidance to drivers.

signs.name: Stop
signs.description: Drivers must bring their vehicle to a complete halt before the stop line or pedestrian crosswalk.
signs.action_required: Halt completely, check cross traffic in all directions, and proceed only when clear.

signs.name: Give Way / Yield
signs.description: Indicates that traffic on the main intersecting road has absolute right of way.
signs.action_required: Slow down, yield right of way to vehicles on your right/main road, stop if necessary.

signs.name: Straight Prohibited / No Entry
signs.description: Entry of all vehicles into this road or street is strictly forbidden from this direction.
signs.action_required: Do not enter. Choose an alternate route.

signs.name: One Way Traffic
signs.description: Traffic is permitted to move only in the specified arrow direction.
signs.action_required: Drive only in the designated lane direction; driving opposite is hazardous and unlawful.

signs.name: U-Turn Prohibited
signs.description: Making a complete 180-degree turnaround is forbidden at this intersection or stretch.
signs.action_required: Proceed straight or make standard turns; do not execute a U-turn.

signs.name: Overtaking Prohibited
signs.description: Overtaking other motor vehicles is strictly forbidden due to narrow road, bridge, or blind curve.
signs.action_required: Stay strictly in your lane behind the leading vehicle without passing.

signs.name: Horn Prohibited (Silence Zone)
signs.description: Sounding electric or mechanical horn is prohibited in this vicinity (near hospitals, schools, courts).
signs.action_required: Do not blow the vehicle horn under any circumstances.

signs.name: No Parking
signs.description: Vehicles must not be parked on this stretch. Brief stopping to alight/board passengers is allowed.
signs.action_required: Do not leave vehicle stationary unattended. Continue moving.
signs.fine_section: MV Act Section 177 / Towing charges apply

signs.name: No Stopping or Standing
signs.description: Neither parking nor temporary stopping of any vehicle is permitted for any reason.
signs.action_required: Keep vehicle in motion; stopping obstructs continuous highway or arterial flow.

signs.name: Speed Limit 50 km/h
signs.description: Maximum permissible speed on this road section is 50 kilometers per hour.
signs.action_required: Maintain vehicle speedometer strictly at or below 50 km/h.

signs.name: Compulsory Sound Horn
signs.description: Mandatory requirement to sound horn before negotiating sharp hill bends or blind curves.
signs.action_required: Blow horn clearly to alert oncoming blind traffic before turning.

signs.name: Compulsory Ahead or Turn Right
signs.description: Vehicles are legally required to either proceed straight or turn right. Left turn is forbidden.
signs.action_required: Follow only the straight or right movement vectors.

signs.name: Right Hairpin Bend
signs.description: A very sharp acute right curve lies immediately ahead on the road.
signs.action_required: Shift to lower gear, reduce speed considerably, and hug your side of the lane.
signs.fine_section: Safety warning against loss of vehicle control

signs.name: Left Hairpin Bend
signs.description: A very sharp acute left curve lies immediately ahead on the road.
signs.action_required: Reduce speed, avoid overtaking, and maintain left lane discipline.

signs.name: Pedestrian Crossing Ahead
signs.description: A zebra crossing for foot pedestrians is situated ahead.
signs.action_required: Slow down, prepare to brake, and come to a stop if pedestrians are waiting to cross.
signs.fine_section: Drivers must give precedence to pedestrians at un-signaled crossings

signs.name: School Ahead
signs.description: Educational institution in vicinity with frequent movement of children.
signs.action_required: Reduce vehicle speed to school zone limits (max 25 km/h) and stay alert for sudden crossing.

signs.name: Roundabout Ahead
signs.description: A rotary traffic circle lies ahead.
signs.action_required: Slow down; traffic already circulating inside the roundabout on your right has priority.
signs.fine_section: Traffic rules of the road regulations 1989

signs.name: Narrow Road Ahead
signs.description: The roadway ahead merges or tapers into a narrower width.
signs.action_required: Adjust lane positioning smoothly, avoid sudden swerving, and merge with care.

signs.name: Narrow Bridge Ahead
signs.description: Bridge width is significantly less than the approaching highway carriageway.
signs.action_required: Yield to oncoming vehicles already crossing the bridge; strictly no overtaking.

signs.name: Slippery Road Ahead
signs.description: Road surface possesses reduced friction due to moisture, oil spills, or loose gravel.
signs.action_required: Avoid sudden acceleration or hard braking; maintain double the following distance.

signs.name: Hospital Ahead
signs.description: Medical facility or emergency hospital located on or near this street.
signs.action_required: Maintain silence, do not honk, and give unhindered clearance to emergency ambulances.

signs.name: First Aid Post
signs.description: Emergency first aid treatment facility available for accident victims.
signs.action_required: Driver information and accident assistance location.

signs.name: Petrol Pump / Fuel Station
signs.description: Vehicle fueling facility situated ahead along this highway.
signs.action_required: Signal properly before turning into the fueling bay.

signs.name: Car Parking Area
signs.description: Designated legal parking lot for four-wheeler personal motor vehicles.
signs.action_required: Park strictly inside the marked bay lines without obstructing driveways.
